title: Blob Royale protocol v3 race mode state
description: The selected terrain corridor's identity, race gates and durations, followed by observed finish standings. Road geometry belongs only to welcome terrain. Each racer's next gate and return countdown are entity components. The generic match.placements array is empty for race because its eliminated_tick does not describe a finish.

road.$comment: Exact name of the selected corridor in this session's retained welcome terrain. Membership is checked at contextual encoding/decoding boundaries, never inferred from array order or gates.

checkpoint_radius.$comment: No greater than the selected terrain corridor's half_width; contextual validation requires this session's terrain.

checkpoints.description: Gate centres in declared order. The last gate is the finish.

standings.description: Recorded finish order; simultaneous finishers share a placement and are appended in ascending entity order. Empty until a racer finishes.

$comment: The 3.0 road identity replaces track and track_half_width mirrors. Exact corridor binding and gate-width admission require retained terrain; arrays and every nested object are closed and bounded here.
